pictures.author: Smartneddy
pictures.observed: Tiered Chinese-style tower: turned-up eave corners, grey barrel-tile lower roofs, green glazed ridge/eave accents, red timber posts/screens, blue/green painted crossbeams and red gourd-like roof finial. Broad lower roof/side wings and a smaller upper roof. Planting, fence, signs and temporary supports are not core building geometry. Exact tier/bay dimensions are estimates.

pictures.observed: Prayer-hall entry/detail: red lacquered timber doors and columns, upper diamond lattice screens, green/red rafters and blue/green painted beams. A view into the hall supplies finish colors; it does not establish the overall exterior roof plan. No calligraphy, ornate painting, photo textures or furnished interior will be copied.
